script_text: Stop, Aquarius—the planets are quietly exposing what you’ve been neglecting at home. For Aquarius rising, Uranus, your modern ruler, sits in your 6th House, keeping your fixed Air element adaptable rather than feeling mentally overwhelmed. Today’s Moon in the 12th House trines Neptune in the 11th, then sextiles Pluto in the 4th, favoring deep restoration and one honest home conversation. In love, Neptune’s trine from the 11th House can surface an intuitive connection through friends or an online community; if partnered, an unspoken worry may complicate a bigger relationship decision. At work, Venus in your 11th House can bring an unexpected paid opportunity, but secure the 10th House contract in writing. Avoid rescuing a friend’s financial mess; the surprise gift is a clear boundary that frees your time. Follow for tomorrow’s Aquarius reading, and comment which house is lighting up.
